note:
Second pass on this hero. The section settings were already correct from the first pass (parallax off, overlay 25, text middle left, mobile image present) and are re-stated here so the plan is self-contained and re-runnable rather than a diff against a state nobody can see.

ONLY ONE THING CHANGES BESIDES THE IMAGES: object-position goes from 93% to right center. That is not tidying — 93% was measured for the v2 photograph, whose jar sits at x 1664-3634 of 3750. This frame's subject runs to x=3711, only 39px short of the edge, so 93% would crop her hand and the jar at 1024 and 1280. Measured across four anchors and four viewports before changing it.

Text max-width relaxes to 29vw accordingly: 371px at 1280 against 385px of measured clear ground, 418px at 1440 against 545px, 500px at 1920 against 1025px.

The two images uploaded by the first pass are left in Shopify Files rather than deleted — removing live media is a stop condition, and they cost nothing sitting there. They are skingenetix-pdrn-collagen-deep-skin-repair-renewal-cream.jpg and skingenetix-pdrn-collagen-skin-repair-renewal-cream-mobile.jpg, and nothing references them once this plan is applied.
